name: Equal Fist
description: Punch with a fist that carries exactly the force of the last blow the user took.

name: Twin Poise
description: Hold two equal weights of qi at the shoulders so any blow tips one and raises the other.

name: Counter Glide
description: Glide opposite to the opponent's step so that the distance between them does not change.

name: Twofold Cancel
description: Set two equal waves of qi against an incoming technique so that it is cancelled between them.

name: Twinned Mend
description: Rest both hands on an ally and bring his wounded side level with his sound side.

name: Equilibrium Lock
description: Draw the foe's limbs to the exact middle between two pulls and hold them there.

name: Twin Settling
description: Settle two weights over the field to press all raging force down to one calm level.

name: Even Return
description: Catch a blow on one pan and return it from the other with exactly the same weight.

name: Perfect Counterweight
description: Take the whole force of a strike into the twin pans and give it back in one equal blow.

name: Beam Jab
description: Jab along the beam of the arms at the point where the foe's weight is lightest.

name: Beam Cover
description: Lay the arms across the front as a level beam that shares a blow between the two ends.

name: Beam Glide
description: Glide along an unseen beam with the weight shifting from one pan to the other.

name: Beam Reading
description: Read which pan of the beam is the heavier in a clash of forces and by how much.

name: Beam Tilt
description: Tilt the opponent's beam by a hard blow to the heavy side so that his stance spills over.

name: Beam Rinse
description: Pass the beam over an ally and wash out whatever weighs one side of him down.

name: Beam Return
description: Swing the beam so that an attack is carried round to the side it came from.

name: Counter Beam
description: Lay an equal beam of force against a mighty technique and cancel it where the two touch.

name: Beam Rally
description: Level the strength of all near allies on the beam until the weakest holds as the strongest.

name: Paired Reckoning
description: Return to the foe the exact measure of harm he has dealt through every guard and press him still.

name: Measure Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries exactly one measure of qi and spends it all on the mark.

name: Measured Ward
description: Fill the ward to the measure of the blow it meets and no more.

name: Measured Glide
description: Glide a measured pace that spends exactly as much strength as the distance asks.

name: Measure Cast
description: Cast a measured bead of qi whose weight is set by the foe's own reserve.

name: Brim Gauge
description: Gauge how full or how drained a nearby person's qi is by the pressure it gives.

name: Brimful Hold
description: Fill the opponent's limbs with his own surplus qi until they are too tight to move.

name: Measured Mend
description: Give an ally what his wound lacks from the surplus of his own body until both are level.

name: Surplus Rinse
description: Draw the excess of poison or fever from an ally and pour it away in even measure.

name: Cupful Parry
description: Cup the force of a thrust in the hand and tip it harmlessly out to the side.

name: Full Measure
description: Pour a whole measure of stored qi into one blow that presses the foe flat to the ground.

name: Gauge Mantle
description: Draw a mantle round the allies that tops up the weak and draws down the overfull.

name: Brimful Absorption
description: Take the surplus force of hostile strikes into the body and give it out as mending to an ally.

name: Planed Palm
description: Strike with a palm planed flat that shaves the force off whatever it meets.

name: Planed Ward
description: Hold a ward planed smooth and level so that no blow finds a rise to bite on.

name: Planed Stride
description: Stride across the open ground at an even pace over every rise and hollow.

name: Flatten Strike
description: Strike downward on the highest part of the foe's stance and level him with the ground.

name: Calm Level
description: Spread a broad calm over an ally's wounds until the pain lies flat and drains away.

name: Evener Hold
description: Hold the foe down to the level of the ground with a plane of qi laid on his back.

name: Levelled Press
description: Plane the whole field flat so that every raised thing in it is pressed down to one level.

name: Planed Canopy
description: Spread a level canopy over the allies that guards them and mends their small hurts.

name: Absolute Level
description: Make the whole field one level so that every technique that needs a rise or a fall fails.

name: Scalebound Palm
description: Strike with a palm bound to the scale so the force is weighed against the foe's guard.

name: Scalebound Ward
description: Hold a ward bound to the anchored scale that holds true against a hard gust.

name: Scalebound Step
description: Take a step bound to the anchor so the body tips neither forward nor back.

name: Scalebound Cast
description: Cast a bead of weighed qi that flies as heavy as the foe's own last strike.

name: Scalebound Sense
description: Weigh a sworn oath on the scale to learn whether the speaker holds to it.

name: Scalebound Hold
description: Hold a technique on the scale until its weight is spent and it can do no harm.

name: Scalebound Mend
description: Lay the wound on the scale and draw it level with sound flesh until it closes.

name: Scalebound Parry
description: Tilt the scale to one side so a strike slides off into the empty pan.

name: Weighed Verdict
description: Weigh the foe's wrongs against the scale and bring down the full measure of them in one blow.

name: Scalebound Mantle
description: Cover sworn allies in a mantle that evens their strength and shields them from a heavy blow.

name: Oath Counterpoise
description: Throw back every strike on the scale as a weighted blow that falls heavier on the oath-breaker.

name: Meanline Palm
description: Strike along the mean line between the user and the foe so the blow lands true.

name: Meanline Ward
description: Hold the ward on the mean line so that pushes from either side cancel on it.

name: Meanline Slip
description: Slip along the mean line between two attackers and let both strikes miss.

name: Meanline Sense
description: Find the mean line of a field by the qi that pulls evenly from either side of it.

name: Meanline Lock
description: Hold the foe on the mean line by drawing his limbs equally toward each side of it.

name: Meanline Cleanse
description: Draw the taint of a curse out of an ally along the mean line of his body.

name: Meanline Rebuke
description: Turn a blow on the mean line and strike the caster with the turned force.

name: Mean Reckoning
description: Reckon the mean between two techniques and strike with that exact force to cancel both.

name: Meanline Rekindle
description: Bring a person whose pulse has just stopped back to the mean line between life and death.

name: Mean Phase
description: Pass through the line between two opposing forces unharmed as each cancels the other.
